Dragons 1.2.5 - breeding fix

Fixed
- Dragons that were told to stay (sneak + right-click) never bred, even after both got a golden apple. Now a dragon in love gets up, walks to its partner, lays the egg together with it and then stays again where it is. Thanks for the report!

Everything from 1.2.4 (the bigger config file and the crash fix after breeding) is included.
